subject: *: Support idle transaction timeout (#48714)
summary: Reviewed only this commit vs first parent, limited to executor/sessionctx changes. `tidb_idle_transaction_timeout` is introduced as a typed unsigned sysvar with range [0, secondsPerYear] in `pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go:2957`, with default `DefTiDBIdleTransactionTimeout=0` in `pkg/sessionctx/variable/tidb_vars.go:1439` and name defined in `pkg/sessionctx/variable/tidb_vars.go:1120`. The session value is stored on `SessionVars.IdleTransactionTimeout` (embedded via `Concurrency`) in `pkg/sessionctx/variable/session.go:2783`, and executor tests cover set/get, type error, and max-value truncation warning behavior in `pkg/executor/set_test.go:902`. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/concurrency within the requested executor/sessionctx scope.
